remarks: Welcome to Sylvan Knoll Section II, one of Stamford's most sought after Co-op communities, ideally located just minutes from the beach, downtown Stamford, and I95. This inviting 2 bedroom, 1bath townhouse offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and privacy. Tucked away off the main circle, this desirable unit enjoys a peaceful setting while remaining close to everything within the community. The thoughtfully designed layout includes a finished lower level, providing flexible living space that's perfect for a family room, home office, playroom, fitness area, or whatever best suits your lifestyle. Step outside to a private patio, ideal for relaxing or entertaining, and enjoy the convenience of ample parking right outside. This home has been well maintained and thoughtfully updated, with recent improvements including new windows (2025), a new A/C compressor (2023), a water heater less than five years old, a new furnace (2020), recessed lighting in the living room (2026), new basement flooring (2026), and many additional updates that make this home truly move in ready. Whether you're a first time purchaser, downsizing, or looking for a low maintenance lifestyle in a prime Stamford location, this home is an exceptional opportunity. Schedule your showing today!
